stories.title: Moldavia: “Quattro droni russi hanno violato il nostro spazio aereo". Raid russo a Kharkiv: 7 morti

en.title: Moldova: "Four Russian drones violated our airspace". Russian raid on Kharkiv: 7 dead
en.summary: Russia conducted a massive missile attack on Kharkiv, striking a pediatric hospital where a child was born in a bunker. Moldova reported airspace violations by Russian drones. Ukraine's president called for stopping Russia at the UN, while the Kremlin commented on a potential invitation to Putin at the G20.

stories.title: Padova, precipita nel vano ascensore di un cantiere e muore. Era il titolare di una ditta

en.title: Padua: falls into elevator shaft at construction site and dies. He was a business owner
en.summary: A company owner fell into an elevator shaft at a construction site in Padua and died. Police discovered the body after family members raised an alarm.

stories.title: Precipita nel vano ascensore di un cantiere e muore

en.title: Falls into elevator shaft at construction site and dies
en.summary: A masonry business owner died after falling into an elevator shaft at a construction site in Padua.

stories.title: Meloni con Bianca Balti, Ghali e Anna Wintour alla cena di gala della Milano Fashion Week

en.title: Meloni with Bianca Balti, Ghali and Anna Wintour at Milan Fashion Week gala dinner
en.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni attended the opening gala dinner of Milan Fashion Week alongside model Bianca Balti, musician Ghali, and Vogue's Global Editorial Director Anna Wintour. The event marked the first attendance by a prime minister at the fashion week in ten years.

stories.title: Padova, cade nel vano ascensore e muore a 51 anni: trovato grazie allo squillo del cellulare

en.title: Padova, man falls into elevator shaft and dies at 51: found thanks to cell phone ring
en.summary: A 51-year-old Albanian-born construction company owner in the Vicenza area fell into an elevator shaft and died. His family raised an alarm after he went missing in the afternoon, and police located his body overnight by calling his phone.

stories.title: Giudice Usa a Trump: “Riammetta alla Casa Bianca i media banditi”

en.title: US Judge to Trump: "Readmit banned media to the White House"
en.summary: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration to restore press access to CNN, MS NOW, and Politico after the president revoked their White House credentials, ruling the decision was made without due process.

stories.title: Trump contro i media, il tribunale interviene: riammesse alla Casa Bianca le tre testate bandite

en.title: Trump against media, court intervenes: three banned outlets readmitted to White House
en.summary: Judge Timothy Kelly ruled in favor of CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, which had been excluded from White House premises after being accused of spreading misinformation.

stories.title: La premier Meloni alla cena di gala della Milano Fashion Week

en.title: Premier Meloni attends Milan Fashion Week gala dinner
en.summary: Italy's premier attended a Milan Fashion Week gala, stating she wanted to show physical support and proximity to the fashion sector during a challenging period despite its continued strong performance.

stories.title: Il giudice blocca Trump: ripristinato l’accesso alla Casa Bianca per Cnn, Ms Now e Politico

en.title: Judge blocks Trump: access to White House restored for CNN, MSNBC and Politico
en.summary: A court suspended a ban preventing three news outlets from accessing the White House, which had challenged the restriction as violating the First Amendment's press freedom protections. The suspension remains in effect for 14 days.

stories.title: Meloni al gala fashion week e non all’Assemblea Onu: “Una figuraccia per l’Italia”

en.title: Meloni at fashion week gala instead of UN Assembly: "An embarrassment for Italy"
en.summary: Italy's prime minister attended a reception at Milan's Royal Palace during fashion week rather than the UN Assembly in New York, drawing criticism from political figures who noted other leaders were present at the global gathering.

stories.title: Arrivo di Xi Jinping negli USA: accoglienza d'onore e vertice alla Casa Bianca

en.title: Arrival of Xi Jinping in the USA: ceremonial welcome and summit at the White House
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in the United States for a three-day state visit from September 23 to 25, 2026, marking his first Washington visit in over a decade.

stories.title: Nucleare, via libera definitivo al Senato. Il ministro Pichetto: “Le prime centrali nel 2033”

en.title: Nuclear power receives final Senate approval. Minister Pichetto: "First plants by 2033"
en.summary: The Senate approved nuclear legislation previously passed by the Chamber of Deputies in June. The energy minister pledges to issue implementing decrees by year-end and projects the first nuclear plants operational by 2033, though opposition parties question the timeline and costs.

stories.title: Hitachi Rail lancia il primo intercity elettrico a batteria. Trenitalia ne ha ordinati sei

en.title: Hitachi Rail launches first battery-electric intercity train. Trenitalia has ordered six
en.summary: Hitachi Rail introduced its first battery-electric intercity train, manufactured in Pistoia and Naples facilities. The train operates on both electrified lines and in battery mode with 100 kilometers of range on non-electrified routes, with Trenitalia placing an order for six units.

stories.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, oltre mille eventi all’insegna della biodiversità

en.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, over one thousand events celebrating biodiversity
en.summary: The Terra Madre Salone del Gusto event is organizing more than one thousand events focused on biodiversity, following a coordination meeting held in Pollenzo the previous year.

stories.title: Da Nestlé a Nespresso a Redion, così Bocconi fa lavorare (e laureare) detenuti

en.title: From Nestlé to Nespresso to Redion, how Bocconi works with (and graduates) prisoners
en.summary: Bocconi University's prison project provides employment and educational opportunities for incarcerated individuals through partnerships with major companies including Nestlé, Nespresso, and Redion.

stories.title: Advanced control solutions acquisisce Ksenia Security e Dea Security

en.title: Advanced control solutions acquires Ksenia Security and Dea Security
en.summary: Advanced control solutions, controlled by Investindustrial, has completed agreements to acquire Ksenia Security and Dea Security, two Italian companies, as part of consolidating Italian-made security capabilities.

stories.title: Data center, Mediterra investe oltre 20 milioni a Carini

en.title: Data center, Mediterra invests over 20 million in Carini
en.summary: Mediterra DataCenters plans to invest more than 20 million euros by the end of 2026 in a data center facility in Carini, as Palermo seeks to strengthen its position in Mediterranean digital infrastructure.
